A '''golden axe''' is an [[Tools#Axe|axe]] of the [[Golden equipment|golden]] tier, crafted from three [[gold ingot]]s and two sticks. It carries both [[Fortune]] I and [[Looting]] I.

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}

=== Loot ===
{{Sources}}

A [[weaponsmith]] can also give a player with Hero of the Village a plain vanilla golden axe, without this one's enchantments or durability.

== Usage ==

=== Woodcutting ===
It keeps the vanilla golden axe's mining speed of 12 and has {{Value|Golden Axe|durability}} durability. Fortune raises its drops from melons and other Fortune-affected blocks. Matcha Flavoured adds beds, candles, cacti and honeycomb blocks to the blocks that axes break quickly.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/block/mineable/axe.json}}</ref>

=== Combat ===
It deals {{Value|Golden Axe|damage}} damage at an attack speed of {{Value|Golden Axe|attackspeed}}, and Looting I increases mob drops. Golden gear comes with its enchantments already applied. They are ordinary enchantments, so they can be combined or removed like any other.

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[gold ingot]]s. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Smelting ingredient ===
{{Uses}}

In a [[blast furnace]] it melts down into one gold ingot.
